article.headline: Byron Ireland scores 19 to lead Nicholls to 78-62 victory over New Orleans
article.description: — Byron Ireland scored 19 points to help Nicholls defeat New Orleans 78-62 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Byron Ireland scores 19 to lead Nicholls to 78-62 victory over New Orleans
article.story: NEW ORLEANS -- — Byron Ireland scored 19 points to help Nicholls defeat New Orleans 78-62 on Monday night. Ireland shot 8 of 11 from the field and 1 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Colonels (16-11, 10-6 Southland Conference). Trae English scored 17 and added eight assists. Robert Brown III hit three 3-pointers and scored 15. Michael Thomas, Leland Coleman and Kohen Rowbatham all scored 12 for the Privateers (4-23, 2-14), who have lost nine in a row. Thomas added 17 rebounds for a double-double. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
